# hostd_public_ips (Data Source)

Public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses reserved on a project, with their PTR hostname and whether each address is in use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostd_public_ips" "main" {
  project_id = hostd_project.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project (`hostd_project`).

### Read-Only

- `ips` (Attributes List) Addresses reserved on the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `attachment` (String) `vm`, `router`, or empty when the address is only reserved.
- `comment` (String) Comment stored with the address.
- `content` (String) PTR hostname.
- `ip` (String) Public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- `status` (String) `attached` or `reserved`.
- `vmid` (Number) VMID when the address is attached to a VM.
